Only authenticated CLOSED, confirmed whole owned process/group exit, stable GPU identity/nonce, exact source inventory, unchanged full cache and durable closure authorize the next ordered model. Unknown exit, source/GPU mismatch, secondary error or persistence failure is a sticky campaign halt.
http_delivery: Each response binds its durable request SHA/size, ID, HTTP SHA, model, nonce, status and body SHA. A verified previously refused no-action response delivery error writes a receipt without changing later arm state. A200 or unknown delivery and receipt persistence failure hard halt. Response binding cost stays inside the original20s gateway budget.
